subject: Recap & next steps: procurement intake and commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@acmeanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: procurement intake and commercial path

Jordan / Procurement team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap of what we agreed and the open asks so we can keep the procurement path moving: 

1) Commercial path preference: you indicated a preference for issuing a PO (enterprise procurement). Please confirm whether purchase orders will be routed via your vendor portal or emailed to AP.

2) Vendor setup: I attached our Redwood Vendor Packet (see Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf) — it includes the standard contract class, billing contact, and our bank wiring details. We also shared a W-9 request template to make it easier if you need anything in a specific format.

3) Tax forms: if you can send your completed W-9 (or W-8 if offshore) that will unblock vendor creation on your side. Jordan mentioned he could get that from legal/ops.

4) Marketplace interest: you asked about Redwood being listed in the Acme Marketplace. We'll follow up with our partnerships team if you'd like to pursue that (it can simplify procurement but takes a bit longer to onboard).

5) Next steps & timing:
   - Jordan / procurement: confirm PO routing and timeline for vendor setup (approx ETA)
   - Jordan: share completed W-9 (or point us to the vendor portal registration link)
   - Dylan: I'll ask Dylan to create a formal quote and docs to attach for PO creation and DocuSign signature if needed.

If helpful, we can also accept payment by card for initial proof-of-concept months to speed start while vendor setup runs in parallel. Let me know which path you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf, W-9_Request_Template.pdf

From: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: procurement intake and commercial path

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We will be using a PO. Our procurement team prefers invoices tied to a PO number and ACH wiring for payments.
- I'm attaching our completed W-9 for Acme (W-9_Acme_Analytics.pdf) so you can share it with your billing.
- Vendor setup will be done through our portal: https://vendorportal.acmeanalytics.com/register/abcd-1234 (I can loop procurement separately if needed).
- Timeline: procurement expects vendor creation within 3–5 business days after we submit the W-9 and bank details.

Regarding marketplace: we'd be interested in exploring the Acme Marketplace option if it doesn't add significant onboarding time — please share what that looks like. For now, PO path is preferred to get started quickly.

Jordan Bell
Head of Data Platforms, Acme Analytics
jordan.bell@acmeanalytics.com

Attachments: W-9_Acme_Analytics.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@acmeanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: procurement intake and commercial path

Jordan — perfect, thanks for the W-9 and the portal link.

Dylan — can you draft a formal quote (PDF) scoped to the POC we discussed (50k tokens/month, 3 month POC) and include Redwood's bill-to info and our bank wiring instructions so Acme can create the PO? If you can also attach the DocuSign-ready agreement we discussed that would be great. I'll keep Neha in the loop for any billing questions.

Jordan — regarding marketplace: short answer is yes we can pursue it. I'll set up a separate intro with Partnerships. For the immediate go-live, we'll proceed with PO + ACH per your preference.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: procurement intake and commercial path

On Fri, Jun 25, 2026 at 4:05 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Dylan — can you draft a formal quote (PDF) scoped to the POC we discussed (50k tokens/month, 3 month POC) and include Redwood's bill-to info and our bank wiring instructions so Acme can create the PO?

Yes — I'll generate the quote and the DocuSign package this morning and send to Jordan + procurement. A couple quick Qs for AP: 
- Who is the vendor contact on your side for portal registration (name + email)?
- Do you require our bank details to be filled into your portal form, or will you edit them on your side after vendor creation?

I should have the Quote-ACME-Redwood-2026-06-25.pdf and DocuSign link by EOD today.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@acmeanalytics.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: procurement intake and commercial path

Hi Marissa / Dylan — thanks for the outreach. A few notes from procurement / AP so we can complete vendor setup quickly: 

1) Portal registration: please register here and use vendor code REDWOOD-2026 when prompted: https://vendorportal.acmeanalytics.com/register/abcd-1234
2) Required items for vendor creation: completed W-9 (received), vendor company address, primary vendor contact, and bank ACH instructions. We can accept bank details either uploaded in the portal or included on your vendor packet PDF.
3) PO flow: once the vendor is created we will issue a PO number and email the PO PDF to ap@acmeanalytics.com (cc the vendor billing contact).
4) Timing: once we have all items vendor creation + PO issuance typically completes in 3 business days.

Please let us know if you prefer us to pull a quote from DocuSign or if you'll attach the quote PDF during portal registration.

Regards,
Acme Analytics Procurement
procurement@acmeanalytics.com

Attachments: (portal link provided)
